decision.summary: A sustained, correlated horizontal ramp in N (up) and E (down) from index 470 to 505 is evident. No opposing return is observed before index 540 (end of allowed_context); both axes continue monotonic motion beyond 505. U-component lacks a coherent offset, only increased noise. Without observed reversal, the interval cannot be confirmed as temporary.

intervals.observation: N-component rises steadily from index 470 to 505; E-component declines steadily over the same interval; U-component shows no coherent trend, only elevated noise. Return to pre-ramp behavior is not observed within allowed_context (ends at 540), and post-505 N/E continue trending (N still rising, E still falling) without reversal—thus return is unobserved.
